name: MacBook Pro 16"
description: Experience unparalleled performance with the 16-inch MacBook Pro featuring the revolutionary M3 Pro chip. With 18GB of unified memory and 1TB SSD storage, this powerhouse delivers lightning-fast speeds for professional workflows, creative projects, and intensive applications. The stunning Liquid Retina XDR display brings your content to life with exceptional clarity and color accuracy.

name: iPhone 15 Pro
description: The iPhone 15 Pro redefines smartphone excellence with its aerospace-grade titanium design, making it the lightest Pro model ever. Powered by the A17 Pro chip, it delivers groundbreaking performance and efficiency. The advanced camera system with 48MP Main camera captures stunning details, while the Action button provides quick access to your favorite functions.

name: Sony WH-1000XM5
description: Immerse yourself in pure silence with the Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones featuring industry-leading noise cancellation technology. Enjoy up to 30 hours of battery life with quick charging that provides 3 hours of playback in just 3 minutes. The exceptional sound quality and comfortable, lightweight design make these perfect for extended listening sessions.

name: Samsung Odyssey G9
description: Dominate your gaming setup with the Samsung Odyssey G9, a massive 49-inch Dual QHD gaming monitor. Featuring an incredible 240Hz refresh rate and 1ms response time, this QLED display delivers buttery-smooth gameplay with vibrant colors and deep contrasts. The 1000R curvature wraps around your field of vision for truly immersive gaming experiences.

name: Logitech MX Keys
description: Elevate your typing experience with the Logitech MX Keys wireless illuminated keyboard. Featuring smart backlighting that automatically adjusts to lighting conditions and your hands' proximity, this keyboard offers perfect stroke keys with comfortable, precise typing. Connect to multiple devices seamlessly and enjoy up to 10 days of battery life on a single charge.

name: Logitech MX Master 3S
description: The Logitech MX Master 3S wireless mouse redefines precision and comfort with its ergonomic design and ultra-fast scrolling. Featuring MagSpeed electromagnetic scrolling and 8K DPI tracking, this mouse offers silent clicking and multi-computer flow capabilities. The advanced ergonomic shape supports your hand and wrist for comfortable all-day use.

name: iPad Pro 12.9"
description: Unleash your creativity with the 12.9-inch iPad Pro powered by the M2 chip. The stunning Liquid Retina XDR display with ProMotion technology and True Tone delivers incredible visual experiences. With 5G capability, Face ID, and pro-level cameras, this tablet transforms how you work, create, and connect while offering up to 10 hours of battery life.

name: Canon EOS R6
description: Capture breathtaking moments with the Canon EOS R6 full-frame mirrorless camera. Featuring a 20MP CMOS sensor, 4K 60p video recording, and advanced Dual Pixel CMOS AF II with animal detection, this camera excels in any shooting scenario. With in-body image stabilization providing up to 8 stops of shake correction, you can shoot sharp images even in challenging conditions.

name: DJI Mini 3 Pro
description: Take to the skies with the DJI Mini 3 Pro, a lightweight drone that doesn't compromise on features. Capture stunning 4K HDR video and 48MP photos with tri-directional obstacle sensing for safe flights. Weighing less than 249g with up to 34 minutes of flight time, this drone is perfect for aerial photography and videography adventures.

name: Apple Watch Series 9
description: Stay connected and healthy with the Apple Watch Series 9 featuring the powerful S9 chip. With advanced health monitoring including ECG, blood oxygen measurement, and heart rate tracking, this smartwatch helps you maintain your wellbeing. The always-on Retina display is 2000 nits bright, and with up to 18 hours of battery life, it keeps up with your busy day.

name: PlayStation 5
description: Enter the next generation of gaming with the PlayStation 5 console. Experience lightning-fast loading with the ultra-high speed SSD, deeper immersion with haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, and 3D Audio. Enjoy stunning 4K gaming at up to 120fps with support for 8K output and ray tracing technology that brings game worlds to life with incredible realism.

name: iPhone 17 Pro Max
description: Experience the future of mobile technology with the iPhone 17 Pro Max. Powered by the revolutionary A19 Bionic chip with neural engine, this device features under-display Face ID for a seamless all-screen design and holographic display technology. With week-long battery life, 6G connectivity, satellite link capabilities, and a quad 108MP camera system with LiDAR 3.0, it redefines what a smartphone can do.
